name: Lightweight HTML engines: litehtml 0.10 + own Direct2D/DirectWrite container, and Sciter.JS 6.0.5.0 host (C++); md4c-html + style.css

variants.notes: best: litehtml 0.10 layout + own D2D/DirectWrite container; first 8 KB of markdown (cut at a heading) parsed+laid out on a worker while the window is created, D2D software (WARP) DC target initialised on a 2nd thread in parallel and the first viewport rasterized into a DIB there; WM_PAINT = BitBlt; IME disabled; after the first frame the rest is laid out as ~16 KB chunk documents by 4 threads (far chunks evicted); /O2 /GL /MT
same layout pipeline, but classic Direct2D ID2D1HwndRenderTarget (hardware D3D device on the default adapter = RTX 5070) created and drawn on the UI thread

Sciter.JS 6.0.5.0 (sciter.dll 19.3 MB) via SciterCreateWindow + SCITER_APP_LOOP, default gfx layer; page = style.css + first 4 KB of markdown (cut at a heading), the rest appended in 16 KB slices after the first frame; t_content = rAF x2 -> Window.this.xcall -> DwmFlush; IME disabled
